A '''Kaaten''' was a bipedal creature found on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] that was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitive]]. The Kaaten could lure its prey by using the force to appear friendly. Kaaten were very solitary creatures with well-defined territorial lines which were only crossed when the Kaaten [[Reproduction/Legends|mated]].<ref name="F&D CR" />
